name: Kids are asleep. You are not.
primary_text: Kids are asleep. You are not. Slack is still open in your head. Write the unfinished thing here. Write what is still running. Walk away quieter.
headline: Get it out of your head.

name: You snapped. Then you hated it.
primary_text: You snapped at them. The review is still running. They got the leftover of your day. Put both on the page before it happens again.
headline: Get it out before you walk back in.

name: Mad in the car. Gentle before you walk in.
primary_text: Talked over at work. Late for pickup. Sitting in the car, mad. Write it here before you walk in. Then you can be gentle.
headline: Write it in the car.

name: Lights out. The review starts again.
primary_text: Lights out. The review starts again. Sleep is waiting on a sentence that will not stop. Write it down. Get a short reflection. Leave it there.
headline: Write it so you can sleep.

name: Nobody can see the weight.
primary_text: Sprint. Dentist. Dinner. Whose turn. All of it stacked in your head. Set it down on a private page. You don't have to hold it all night.
headline: Set it down.

name: The house got quiet. The loop got louder.
primary_text: You still owe that reply. The house got quiet and the loop got louder. Write the loop here. Keep the night.
headline: Write the loop. Keep the night.

name: Engine off. You're not ready.
primary_text: Engine off. Driveway. The day is still in your chest. Write the fragment before you have to be on again. One minute. Then go inside.
headline: One minute. Then go inside.

name: They're asleep. You're still in the meeting.
primary_text: They're asleep. You're still presenting in your head. Dump the meeting on a private page. Then you get to be off.
headline: Dump the meeting. Be off.

name: Two conversations. One chest.
primary_text: The one at work. The one you just had in the kitchen. Both still playing. Write them here so sorry isn't the last thing in the room.
headline: Get both out of your head.

name: You don't need the right words.
primary_text: You don't need the right words. You need it out. Write the half-thought. Get a short reflection. Walk away. The night can start.
headline: Write the half-thought.

name: The ChatGPT tab is still open.
primary_text: ChatGPT will keep answering as long as you keep typing. The review stays open. Write the fragment here. Then walk away.
headline: Close the tab. Keep the night.

name: You asked it what to say tomorrow.
primary_text: You asked ChatGPT what to say tomorrow. It gave you three versions. Now you're editing them in bed. Put the one sentence on the page. Then stop.
headline: Write it. Then stop.

name: The paste.
primary_text: The standup, the names, the line from the review. That's in a chat window. Write it on a page that's yours.
headline: Keep it on your page.

name: You started briefing it.
primary_text: You opened ChatGPT to dump the day. Then you started explaining yourself to it. The ugly line never landed. Write the half-thought here.
headline: Write the ugly line.

name: You can't find the sentence.
primary_text: Three months of ChatGPT. You can't find the sentence you wrote. It's under the answers. Put it here. Dated. Yours.
headline: Keep the sentence.

name: Same name. Again.
primary_text: Same coworker. Same heat. Again. ChatGPT never stacked the nights. Write it here. The page keeps it.
headline: The page remembers.

name: Next to the regex.
primary_text: Your 2am spiral is sitting next to the regex. Same sidebar. Someone walks past. Write it on a page that's only this.
headline: Keep this off that tab.

name: It sided with you.
primary_text: ChatGPT sided with you. You closed the laptop more sure. Still awake. Put the fragment on the page. Leave it there.
headline: Put it down. Leave it.
